doc.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
doc.interviewee: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor

title: Keppard's drinking and whether he could read music
summary: Taylor says whiskey ruined Keppard and Bradshaw, and that Keppard could read music or learned by ear.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, did liquor finally get the... Oh...

Now, Freddie Kaepern when he was with Charlie Cook now. Every night he's a quart of whiskey. That's started out with. That's why I was the same thing. I played with Bradshaw there. At the Regal Theater. And he drank whiskey with a pitcher for us. Pitcher, whiskey. Drinking glass for us. Both of them have a tremendous man in there. And whiskey got both of them.
How could Keppert play a show if he couldn't read?
Well, Keppert could read. He could.
Well, you could teach it to him off the xylophone or he could read. Yeah.
